exact_theorem.classification_soundness: a valid ratio enclosure wholly outside the thresholds implies its class
exact_theorem.finite_hamming_ball: the completion set is the finite union of subsets of size at most r
exact_theorem.fixed_prediction_extrema: enumeration attains the minimum and maximum squared holdout loss
exact_theorem.radius_monotonicity: envelope minimum is nonincreasing and maximum nondecreasing in r
exact_theorem.radius_zero_recovery: r=0 recovers the TPC-307 native exclusive holdout

protocol.completion_rule: flip at most r binary labels on each native exclusive holdout
protocol.fit_lock: reuse TPC-307 common ambient coefficients and prefix
protocol.ratio_rule: right envelope holdout MSE / left envelope holdout MSE
protocol.strict_classification: right lower iff upper ratio<0.9; left lower iff lower ratio>1.1
